answer: A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. Because the forge beacon is unpredictable until close, the ember panel cannot be arranged, and the pigment audit records the draw inputs for every case. The 9 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
